description: We're an Australian premium e-commerce retailer — pool tables, arcade machines, pinball, kegerators, saunas and more. We do $10M in revenue and we're scaling to $40M over the next two years. We run our own warehousing, national delivery and an installation team. We're ambitious, we move fast, and we are dead serious about fixing our finance function properly this time. We're looking for a Senior Financial Controller to take full ownership of our books, rebuild our Xero from the ground up, and turn it into the system the business actually steers by. This is a long-term, full-time, ongoing role. It is not a project, not a tidy-up, and not a part-time advisory seat. READ THIS BEFORE APPLYING — WE'RE BEING COMPLETELY STRAIGHT WITH YOU Our books are not in good shape, and we're not going to pretend otherwise. Xero is disconnected from our inventory system. Our cost of goods is inflated and nobody can fully explain why. Our chart of accounts can't show us profit by product category or by department. We've had two bookkeepers and two senior finance people through this business and the books are no better than a year ago. We have strong data sitting in our other systems — Shopify, Unleashed, Polar Analytics — but nothing ties together in Xero, and Xero is not currently a source of truth. We are telling you this upfront because we want someone who reads that and gets interested, not nervous. If untangling a genuine mess and building order out of it is the work you're best at and enjoy most, keep reading. If you want a clean set of books to gently maintain, this is the wrong role and we'll both know it quickly. WHAT THIS ROLE ACTUALLY IS You will own the finance function. Not assist it — own it. In your first months the job is heavy reconstruction: you will pull apart what's wrong, rebuild the Xero chart of accounts properly, and rebuild trust in every number. Once it's clean, you run it — month-end, management accounts, cash flow, reporting — and you keep it immaculate. You'll work directly with the CEO and closely with our operations team, and you'll be the person who can answer, with confidence and evidence, “are we actually making money, and where?” WHAT YOU'LL DELIVER The headline outcomes we are hiring you to produce: - Xero rebuilt as the single source of truth — a clean, correctly structured chart of accounts the leadership team trusts without second-guessing. - Profit visibility by product category — pool tables, arcade, pinball, kegerators, dartboards, LED and furniture — so we finally know which categories make money and which don't.
